summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests lisocabtagene maraleucel (liso-cel, also called Breyanzi) as first-line treatment for adults with primary central nervous system lymphoma who are not eligible for a transplant. The record lists study drugs given at specified doses on specified days, but the route, length of treatment and frequency are not stated. The main outcome measure is not stated in the record.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa lisocabtagene maraleucel (liso-cel, también llamado Breyanzi) como tratamiento de primera línea para adultos con linfoma primario del sistema nervioso central que no son elegibles para un trasplante. El registro indica medicamentos del estudio en dosis específicas en días específicos, pero la vía, la duración del tratamiento y la frecuencia no se indican. El registro no indica la medida de resultado principal.
who_for: Adults 18 or older with histologically confirmed primary CNS lymphoma.
Not eligible for transplant per physician assessment, with age 65 or older or HCT-CI score of 3 or more.
Suitable, per investigator, for high-dose methotrexate-based treatment.
Disease responded to prior high-dose methotrexate, with complete or partial response.
ECOG performance status of 0, 1, or 2, with no prior experimental treatment for PCNSL.
not_for: Secondary CNS lymphoma caused by systemic disease.
Primary intraocular or vitreoretinal lymphoma, isolated CSF disease, or relapsed or refractory PCNSL.
Another cancer not in remission for at least 2 years, with listed exceptions.
Prior CAR T-cell or other genome-editing gene therapy, HIV, or active hepatitis B or C.
Active autoimmune disease needing immunosuppression, or prior allogeneic or solid organ transplant needing immunosuppression.
